h: Unverified claims about Regina Daniels' family and close circle spread online
p: Nollywood actress Regina Daniels is trending after a wave of unconfirmed claims about her family and people close to her spread on Instagram. Posts suggest her mother has raised concerns about some people in her daughter's circle, but the details being shared have not been backed up by any official source. Neither Regina nor her family has publicly responded, and Trend Naija has not been able to verify any of the reports.
more: There is no confirmation of any police involvement, despite claims being shared online.
None of the people mentioned in the posts has been shown to have done anything wrong.
Fans are urging caution, saying matters of family and health deserve privacy until the facts are clear.
